tools.name: nuclei
tools.useForSulitNow: Scan every scrape source for known CVEs/misconfig before trusting data
tools.notes: slow on this sandbox network; best in CI

tools.name: subfinder
tools.useForSulitNow: Passive subdomain discovery of data-provider domains

tools.name: naabu
tools.useForSulitNow: Fast port scan to find data endpoints on provider hosts

tools.name: katana
tools.useForSulitNow: Crawl provider pages to find hidden API/JSON endpoints for scraping

tools.name: ffuf
tools.useForSulitNow: Fuzz provider hosts for API paths (api, v1, json ...)

tools.name: amass
tools.useForSulitNow: Heavy subdomain/ASN mapping of provider networks

tools.name: bettercap
tools.notes: needs root netifaces — limited in sandbox

tools.name: nmap
tools.useForSulitNow: Detailed service/version scan of provider hosts
tools.notes: NOT usable here — no net routes in sandbox; use naabu

tools.name: nikto
tools.useForSulitNow: Web-server misconfig scan of scrape sources

tools.name: sqlmap
tools.useForSulitNow: Optional SQLi check on discovered query endpoints

tools.name: hydra
tools.useForSulitNow: Auth brute-force (NOT for scraping; documented only)
tools.notes: do not use on sources without authorization

tools.name: mitmproxy
tools.useForSulitNow: Local reverse/transparent proxy for debugging scraped APIs
tools.notes: useful as a debugging MITM for scrapers

tools.name: httpx(go)
tools.useForSulitNow: Probe which discovered hosts are alive + fingerprint
tools.notes: STANDALONE BINARY NOT INSTALLED — PATH has Python httpx CLI; install via go

tools.name: tshark
tools.useForSulitNow: Packet capture analysis of scraper traffic

tools.name: john
tools.useForSulitNow: Password hash cracking (documented only, authorized use)

summary.verdict: All core recon/security tools installed. Run heavy scans in CI (fast network). nmap needs a real host environment; PD httpx standalone binary not yet installed.
